new_articles.title: Auto sector sees strong Dhanteras deliveries, expects momentum to continue till Diwali
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Auto sector sees strong Dhanteras deliveries, expects momentum to continue till Diwali'이다. Automakers and dealerships reported strong Dhanteras deliveries following robust Navratri sales, with Maruti Suzuki expecting over 30,000 deliveries and Tata Motors targeting 12,000 units. Hyundai anticipates nearly 14% growth in festive deliveries. Dealers reported healthy demand across vehicle segments, while the pre-owned car market also witnessed a significant sales uptick. Hyundai anticipates nearly 14% growth in festive deliveries Dealers reported healthy demand across vehicle segments, while the pre-owned car market also witnessed a significant sales uptick Maruti Suzuki estimates its deliveries to be over 30,000 units today, compared to 50,000 deliveries in the last Dhanteras, which the company said happened across two days Tata Motors expects deliveries of 12,000 units, while Hyundai India's CEO Tarun Garg said the automaker expects to record almost 14 pc growth in Dhanteras and Diwali deliveries to 16,000 units "What is particularly encouraging is that the strong momentum is not limited to one day. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
